auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.XCL_011
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.XCL_010 = a.XCL_001
JOIN member m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_034
WHERE e.XCL_012 = 'MU 215'
  AND e.XCL_013 != 'Fundraiser'
  AND m.XCL_037 = 'X-Large'
GROUP BY e.XCL_010
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_034) > 2
